claim: Derive a routine's original time by running the routine itself on the snapshot's memory at build time, or fit it to the drawing routines' time, rather than guessing a constant.

evidence.text: Time by size and shift comes from running the routine itself at build time on the snapshot's memory: no fitting from recordings, hooks within 0.01% at the first try.
evidence.quote: time on the snapshot's memory: no fitting from recordings, and the hooks came out within 0.01% at the first try

evidence.text: Update time fitted against the drawing routines' lines (target = 5.6 x their lines + a constant): least squares in JNext over 3 runs of 800 updates, residual 0.4 ms an update on 70.
evidence.quote: Least squares in JNext over 3 runs of 800 updates: residual 0.4 ms an

evidence.text: Targets fitted on the plain build in JNext: copy 21 T r c + 140 T r; fits by seed run 19.9 to 23.0 r c and 132 to 139 r (screen contention).
evidence.quote: copy 21 T r c + 140 T r (r rows, c columns; the fits by seed run 19.9 to 23.0 r c, 132 to 139 r: screen contention)
